# African American Registry

> > A comprehensive digital archive preserving African American history, culture, and contributions through video interviews, educational resources, and community dialogue.

The African American Registry features firsthand accounts from educators, activists, artists, and community members including Terence Blanchard, Rev. Carl Walker, Thurgood Marshall scholars, and youth voices. The site documents experiences spanning civil rights, music, religion, education, and cultural identity through video interviews and community discussion.

## Key Topics

- African American history
- Civil rights activism
- Black community and culture
- Music education and gospel music
- Youth perspectives and experiences
- Religion and faith traditions
- Legal advocacy and justice
- Theater and performing arts
- Racial identity and generational dialogue
- Educational leadership
- Social justice movements
- Cultural preservation
- Community empowerment
- Artistic expression
- Intergenerational wisdom

## Civil Rights & Legal Advocacy

- [Thurgood Marshall, William D. Green](https://aaregistry.org/video/thurgood-marshall-pt-1-william-d-green): William D. Green discusses Thurgood Marshall's legal influence
- [My Work at the NAACP's Legal Defense Fund, Theodore Shaw](https://aaregistry.org/video/my-tenure-at-the-legal-defense-fund-theodore-shaw): Theodore Shaw reflects on civil rights work at NAACP Legal Defense Fund
- [The Million Man March (Mission), Dr. Maulana Karenga](https://aaregistry.org/video/million-man-march-part-1-maulana-karenga): Dr. Maulana Karenga discusses Million Man March mission and impact
- [Fighting Apartheid, Richard Lapchick](https://aaregistry.org/video/fighting-apartheid-richard-lapchick): Richard Lapchick on sports activism against South African apartheid
- [Career Advice (Law), Pamela Alexander](https://aaregistry.org/video/law-career-advice-pamela-alexander): Judge Pamela Alexander provides legal career guidance and activism tips

## Music & Performing Arts

- [My Treasured Music Career Moments, Terence Blanchard](https://aaregistry.org/video/treasured-career-moments-terence-blanchard): Grammy musician Terence Blanchard reflects on career highlights
- [The Uniqueness of Gospel Music, Rev. Carl Walker](https://aaregistry.org/video/gospel-musics-uniqueness-carl-walker): Rev. Carl Walker explores gospel music's unique cultural significance
- [My Treasured Moments in Learning and Teaching the Piano, Rev. Carl Walker](https://aaregistry.org/video/treasured-moments-learning-and-teaching-piano-carl-walker): Rev. Carl Walker shares his piano teaching and learning experiences
- [Theater And Today's Black Community, Harry Waters Jr.](https://aaregistry.org/video/theater-and-todays-black-community-harry-waters-jr): Harry Waters Jr. discusses theater's role in Black community

## Youth Voices & Student Perspectives

- [Being Called Fake, Acting White (bullying), (12th grade) Lamar Roberts](https://aaregistry.org/video/fake-acting-white-taunting-lamar-roberts): 12th grader Lamar Roberts on bullying and racial identity struggles
- [Black Critique, Felicia Johnson](https://aaregistry.org/video/black-critique-felicia-johnson): College student Felicia Johnson shares youth views on Black community
- [Generation Differences, Brian Kasoro](https://aaregistry.org/video/generation-differences-brian-kasoro): Brian Kasoro explores intergenerational perspectives in Black America
- [My Advice to Middle School Students (10th grade), Fardousa Ahmed](https://aaregistry.org/video/advice-to-middle-school-students-high-school-senior): High school student Fardousa Ahmed shares academic success advice

## Faith & Spiritual Perspectives

- [The Color Of Jesus, Dennis Ogelsby](https://aaregistry.org/video/jesus-a-viewpoint-dennis-ogelsby): Pastor Dennis Ogelsby shares African American perspective on Jesus
- [Longevity And The Bible, Rev. Noah Smith](https://aaregistry.org/video/longevity-and-the-bible-rev-noah-smith): Rev. Noah Smith discusses longevity and biblical perspectives

## Community & Cultural Identity

- [Black Love, Dr. Reatha Clark King](https://aaregistry.org/video/we-are-a-story-reatha-clark-king): Dr. Reatha Clark King discusses Black love and community values
- [A Latin Perspective Of Race And Class, Catalina Carbonell](https://aaregistry.org/video/a-latin-perspective-of-race-and-class-catalina-carbonell): Educator Catalina Carbonell shares Colombian perspective on race/class
- [My Career Advice For Women, Josie Thomas](https://aaregistry.org/video/career-advice-for-women-josie-thomas): CBS executive Josie Thomas offers career guidance for women
- [My Personal Admiration, Emanuel Donaby](https://aaregistry.org/video/admiration-emanuel-donaby): Freedom School director Emanuel Donaby shares personal reflections

## Community Resources

- [Discussion Board](https://aaregistry.org/discussion-board): Community forum for African American history discussion and resources
